title: Sam and the Ham
lines: Dad had a ham in a pan.
Sam the cat had a nap on a mat.
The ham was hot. Sam ran at the pan!
Sam got a bit of ham and ran.
Sam hid in a bag and sat and sat.
Dad had jam on a bun. Sam ran up.
"You can have a bit, Sam," said Dad.

questions.ask: What did Sam take from the pan?
questions.listenFor: A bit of the ham. It is said in the story. If they are stuck, read that line again and stop right before the answer.
In a bag. Have them find the word bag on the page and touch it - proving it beats remembering it.

questions.ask: Do you think Dad stayed cross with Sam? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: No wrong answer. Listen for a reason from the story - Dad offered Sam a bit at the end, or Sam ran back to him. The because is what you are after.
